data.exact_reserve_text: The 2017 calendar year GAAP result is a loss of $2.6 million (combined ratio 100.8%). This consists of profits of $2.7 million and $0.6 million on the 2015 and prior and 2016 years of account respectively, while the 2017 year of account produced a calendar year loss of $5.9 million.

prior_year_events.impact_description: Included in Energy result; noted as the largest man-made loss for 2016; however the Energy class still made a positive contribution to the Underwriting Balance.

named_events.loss_description: Anticipated aggregate losses less than $3.5m in total; $2m from Hurricanes Harvey Irma and Maria combined.

data.standardized_narrative: Opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2017 were $51.924m. During 2017 the syndicate recorded an overall net prior-year release of approximately $3.3m (a release of reserves on prior years), driven primarily by favourable claims development and reinsurance recoveries across closed years (including closed 2007-2014 years and the 2015 year). Current-year catastrophe activity in 2017 (Hurricanes Harvey/Irma/Maria and Californian wildfires) was modest for the Syndicate and quantified separately, while Energy exposure included the prior Jubilee oil field loss (2016).
raw_causal_phrases: all of these years combined produced a surplus which contributed both to the calendar year result and the closing 2015 account result.
This consists of profits of $2.7 million and $0.6 million on the 2015 and prior and 2016 years of account respectively
It is pleasing that all classes, including those in startup, have made positive contributions to the Underwriting Balance.
This result for Energy includes exposure on the Ghanaian Jubilee oil field loss, the largest man-made loss for 2016.

The anticipated aggregate losses emanating from the series of unusually severe natural catastrophe events are small and anticipated to be less than $3.5m ($2m from Hurricanes Harvey Irma and Maria combined and $1.5m from Californian wildfires).
At thirty-six months the account has produced a profit of $3.7 million

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from Statement of Financial Position (Claims outstanding) (closing 2016 equals opening 2017). Prior-year development derived from the year-of-account result breakdown in the Underwriter's Report (profits on 2015 & prior and 2016 years totalling $3.3m release). No explicit gross 'movement in prior year's provision' line with a single gross amount was present; therefore the year-of-account breakdown was used as the primary quantified source. Amounts are in the report's native currency (USD).
